title: Learning Infinite-Horizon Average-Reward CMDPs via State Augmentation
abstract: arXiv:2609.39093v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study infinite-horizon average-reward constrained Markov decision processes (CMDPs) under the weakly communicating assumption. Existing high-probability guarantees for this setting either require computationally inefficient algorithms or have suboptimal dependence on the number of interactions $T$. We propose, to the best of our knowledge, the first computationally efficient algorithm that achieves $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{T})$ regret and cumulative constraint violation with high probability in the tabular setting. The $\sqrt{T}$ dependence is optimal up to logarithmic factors. Our approach incorporates cumulative constraint violation into the state and defines a reshaped reward through differences of a Huber potential. The added state determines the penalty on further violations while the reward function remains fixed on the augmented state space. translated_title: 通过状态增广学习无限时域平均奖励约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDPs）
translated_abstract: 我们研究弱通信假设下的无限时域平均奖励约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDPs）。针对该设置，现有的高概率保证要么需要计算效率低下的算法，要么对交互次数 $T$ 的依赖是次优的。据我们所知，我们提出了首个计算高效的算法，该算法在表格（tabular）设置下以高概率实现 $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{T})$ 的遗憾值和累积约束违反。其中 $\sqrt{T}$ 的依赖性在对数因子意义下是最优的。我们的方法将累积约束违反纳入状态之中，并通过 Huber 势函数的差分定义了一个重塑的奖励函数。新增的状态决定了对进一步约束违反的惩罚，同时奖励函数在增广状态空间上保持固定。由于新增的状态具有已知的确定性动力学，因此只需对原始的转移进行学习。
tldr: 该论文提出了首个计算高效的无限时域平均奖励CMDP算法，通过将累积约束违反纳入状态增广并结合基于Huber势函数差分的奖励重塑，以高概率实现了对数因子内最优的 $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{T})$ 遗憾值和累积约束违反。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the first computationally efficient algorithm for infinite-horizon average-reward CMDPs, achieving optimal $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{T})$ regret and constraint violation with high probability via state augmentation that incorporates cumulative constraint violation and reward shaping based on Huber potential differences.
